svg.text: Panels use the exact columns in the literature table, then derive readable classes for analysis type, method family, country, scale, oxygen modality,
energy source, measured endpoint, sample-size class, and observation-window class. This is an exploration surface, not final systematic-review coding.
Fully labeled small multiples: oxygen-system detail vs energy-system detail
Every paper is labeled by ID + first author + year. Faceting by analytical type makes the label pile-up survivable enough for exploration.

Panel I. Observation window class by analytical type
• Coupled technical evidence: 18 papers; oxygen-detailed but energy-thin: 40; energy-detailed but oxygen-thin: 2; thin/ambiguous in both: 34.
• Clinical trials cluster on oxygen modality and mortality/SpO2 endpoints, but many still treat grid or backup as context rather than a measured
• Solar/autonomy papers are the strongest bridge between oxygen and energy because the intervention bundles oxygen production with electricity source
• There is very little literature that measures power quality, voltage/frequency, kWh, diesel dependence, or outage duration as oxygen-system variables,
which is exactly the DRC3a opening.
• The DRC/North Kivu-specific material appears mostly in functionality, implementation, or contextual evidence rather than trial evidence, so DRC3a
should own the infrastructure measurement contribution instead of trying to mimic clinical oxygen RCTs.
